target: Reproduce a stated result for sample size using a prospective power and precision worksheet. Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.

competency.title: Reproduce sample size — real time
competency.outcome: Reproduce a stated result for sample size using a prospective power and precision worksheet. Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.

topic_kernel.artifact: a prospective power and precision worksheet
topic_kernel.measure: required sample size under stated effect

competency.practice_task: Produce a rerun manifest with data, version, seeds and commands grounded in a prospective power and precision worksheet.
competency.setting_constraint: Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.
required_evidence: a rerun manifest with data, version, seeds and commands
Include p95 latency, timeout behavior and rollback trace.
Report required sample size under stated effect with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: claiming significance after repeated peeking.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of sample size.
Practice: the rerun agrees within a predeclared tolerance.
Measurement: report required sample size under stated effect against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for claiming significance after repeated peeking; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
